$comment: The fish and plant lists' filters (apps/site/src/scripts/filter.ts): which ones fit what the reader set (every figure known and fitting) and which may fit (nothing known rules them out, but a figure the filter asks about is missing). The site's tests run filter.ts on these cases, and the iOS app's tests run its own filters (AquaTomeKit Handbook/Filters.swift): both must answer `fit` and `unsure` exactly, in this order. Species figures are the app index's (tempC, ph, tankCm, difficulty on the site's 1–8 scale); plants' are their care (light, co2, difficulty 1–3).

speciesCases.note: a 60 cm tank: the ones that need no longer; those without a length may fit
26 °C, both ends of a range count
easy and medium (5 on the 1–8 scale) and pH 6.8
everything set: one known figure that doesn't fit rules a fish out
30 °C in a 60 cm tank: a known temperature that doesn't fit rules a fish out though its tank length is missing

plantCases.note: medium light: plants that need as much or less
no CO₂: plants that grow without it, an optional one too
easy only (1 on the 1–3 scale), with low light: a plant known to be harder is out, though its light is unknown
